title: Molecular dynamics simulations of human cohesin subunits identify DNA binding sites and their potential roles in DNA loop extrusion
authors: Chenyang Gu; Shoji Takada; Giovani B. Brandani; Tsuyoshi Terakawa
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟预测人类cohesin亚基的DNA结合位点并探讨其在DNA环挤出中的作用，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作机制研究，方法为MD模拟，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但对蛋白-DNA结合位点预测与动态机制建模有借鉴价值。
abstract: The SMC complex cohesin mediates interphase chromatin structural formation in eukaryotic cells through DNA loop extrusion. Here, we sought to investigate its mechanism using molecular dynamics simulations. To achieve this, we first constructed the amino-acid-residue-resolution structural models of the cohesin subunits, SMC1, SMC3, STAG1, and NIPBL. By simulating these subunits with double-stranded DNA molecules, we predicted DNA binding patches on each subunit and quantified the affinities of these patches to DNA using their dissociation rate constants as a proxy. Then, we constructed the structural model of the whole cohesin complex and mapped the predicted high-affinity DNA binding patches on the structure. From the spatial relations of the predicted patches, we identified that multiple patches on the SMC1, SMC3, STAG1, and NIPBL subunits form a DNA clamping patch group. The simulations of the whole complex with double-stranded DNA molecules suggest that this patch group facilitates DNA bending and helps capture a DNA segment in the cohesin ring formed by the SMC1 and SMC3 subunits. In previous studies, these have been identified as critical steps in DNA loop extrusion. Therefore, this study provides experimentally testable predictions of DNA binding sites implicated in previously proposed DNA loop extrusion mechanisms and highlights the essential roles of the accessory subunits STAG1 and NIPBL in the mechanism.
abstract_zh: SMC复合物黏连蛋白通过DNA环挤压介导真核细胞间期染色质结构形成。在此，我们旨在利用分子动力学模拟研究其机制。为实现此目标，我们首先构建了黏连蛋白亚基SMC1、SMC3、STAG1和NIPBL的氨基酸残基分辨率结构模型。通过将这些亚基与双链DNA分子进行模拟，我们预测了每个亚基上的DNA结合斑块，并以其解离速率常数作为代理量化了这些斑块对DNA的亲和力。随后，我们构建了整个黏连蛋白复合物的结构模型，并将预测的高亲和力DNA结合斑块映射到该结构上。根据预测斑块的空间关系，我们识别出SMC1、SMC3、STAG1和NIPBL亚基上的多个斑块形成一个DNA夹持斑块组。整个复合物与双链DNA分子的模拟表明，该斑块组促进DNA弯曲，并有助于在SMC1和SMC3亚基形成的黏连蛋白环中捕获一个DNA片段。在以往研究中，这些已被确定为DNA环挤压的关键步骤。因此，本研究提供了对先前提出的DNA环挤压机制中涉及的DNA结合位点的实验可测试预测，并强调了辅助亚基STAG1和NIPBL在该机制中的关键作用。
